purpose: Teach: 実写/か国/捧げる/煽り/引っ張ら/鵜呑み/広める/築か

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広告、実写を増やす方針、検討中だ。
lines.en: We're currently considering expanding the use of live-action in our advertising.
lines.style: Even, measured opening. Clear enunciation on key business terms. Composed but engaged—the tone of someone laying out a thought he's already settled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。十か国で同時展開、可能です。
lines.en: Yes. We can roll that out simultaneously across ten countries.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Each clause lands cleanly. Professional competence without inflection—he's stating capability as fact, not seeking approval.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者は、事業に人生を捧げる姿勢を残した。
lines.en: The founder left us with a legacy of dedication to the business. That matters.
lines.style: Slight weight on the first clause. Reflective pause before the final sentence. Quiet invocation—not sentimental, but steady and grounding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合の煽り、過剰反応しないよう、対応します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll respond without overreacting to whatever our competitors throw at us.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Steady pace. The reassurance of someone who's heard the instruction and knows exactly what it means.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 短期の市場に引っ張られないよう、長期視点を持て。
lines.en: Keep the long view. Don't let short-term market noise pull you off course.
lines.style: Deliberate and direct. Slight emphasis on 'long'—not lecturing, but insisting. The tone of someone who has seen companies stumble this way before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報道を鵜呑みにせず、独自分析、続けます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep running our own analysis instead of just taking news at face value.
lines.style: Confirming and grounded. Measured pace. The tone of someone already thinking this way, restating it as commitment rather than instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ブランドを広める努力、絶やすな。
lines.en: Don't let your efforts to build the brand go dormant.
lines.style: Command without harshness. Clean attack on the opening word. The weight of expectation—not unkind, but unambiguous.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新市場でのブランド、地道に築かれていきます。
lines.en: Yes. The brand in new markets will be built steadily, piece by piece.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Slow, deliberate pace—almost meditative. The tone of someone describing work he knows will take time and is at peace with that.
